name: Idaho
dueDateNotes: Idaho follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Idaho conforms to the federal standard deduction, so your Idaho tax starts from your federal taxable income and applies a flat 5.3% above the exempt amount ($4,811 single / $9,622 married).
uniqueFacts: Idaho has a flat 5.3% income tax, and income below $4,811 (single) or $9,622 (married) is not taxed at all.
Idaho conforms to the federal standard deduction, so your Idaho taxable income starts from your federal taxable income.
Idaho had not posted its 2026 rate schedule when this page was built, so it uses the latest published (2025) 5.3% rate; the federal figures here are already 2026.
